name: Threshold Church
tagline: A church for people who thought church wasn't for them.

campuses.name: Riverside
campuses.note: Our original site. Free parking behind the building.

campuses.name: East Austin
campuses.note: Launched 2024. Meets in the school auditorium.

campuses.name: Online
campuses.note: Not a lesser option. There is a team in the chat every week.

steps.name: Come once
steps.body: That is the whole first step. Sit at the back, leave straight after, tell nobody your name. Thousands of people have started exactly like that.

steps.name: Get baptised
steps.body: If you have decided to follow Jesus and haven't been baptised, we do this four times a year in the river. No class to pass first.

steps.name: Join a group
steps.body: Eight to twelve people, meeting in someone's front room, most weeks. This is where church stops being an event you attend.

steps.name: Serve a team
steps.body: Coffee, kids, sound, parking, setup. Two hours a month is a real contribution and we will train you.

events.name: Baptism Sunday
events.description: In the river at Riverside, straight after the 11am. Bring a towel and someone who should see it.

events.name: Newcomers' Lunch
events.description: Free lunch, no pitch, no sign-up sheet. Meet a few staff and ask anything.

breakdown.label: Local outreach
breakdown.note: food pantry, ESL, recovery, school partnership

figures.label: of us serve on a team
figures.note: we would like it to be half
